items.html: However, Bina and the Gevurot and the lower half of the Daat and the upper half of the Daat — these remain clothed within the NNH of Tevuna. And they too departed from ZA; but they did not remain in the aspect of Makifim like the others, in order to shine from there, from the aspect of the impression that rises also in the aspect of sleep, as mentioned by us in the matter of the Tefillin. And these were clothed within the Nukva, as will be stated afterward. And afterward, they return to depart from the Nukva, and return first to join with Hochma and the Hasadim, also in the aspect of Makifim together with them. And to do this, another coupling is needed in Aba and Ima.
